featured_reviews.review_text:
Ambica Cycles has always been my go-to for anything bike related. Jayesh is super helpful, always stocked, and even arranges things on demand if needed. This time when I wanted to upgrade my road bike, I waited for Ronit Debnath their weekend bike-fit wizard- because I really wanted his call before buying. And man, he nailed it. Picked up the Cannondale SuperSix he suggested, and after just 3-4 rides, the bike feels unbelievably smooth and perfectly dialed in. The fit he did has completely changed how i ride and genuinely feel like getting on the saddle every single day now.
Thanks a ton, jayesh and Ronit.
